description: Rules the specification itself declares non-testable. Every entry must name a FeatureId whose `Conformance` cell is NOT_COVERED, explain why no executable case can exist, cite the normative text, and state the condition under which the exemption must be re-examined. `python tools/features_coverage.py --strict` fails if an entry is malformed, unknown, stale or hides an uncited rule.

exemptions.reason: La ligne declare elle-meme « pass : aucun (oracle absent) » et sa colonne Conformance vaut NOT_COVERED. La machine abstraite du noyau pur n'a aucune forme executable : MACH-1.4 fixe son etat a NOT_IMPLEMENTED et interdit de citer un resultat machine comme preuve. Inventer un cas reviendrait a inventer un oracle, ce qui est precisement le faux PASS que T2 doit interdire.
exemptions.review_condition: Revoquer cette exemption des qu'une machine abstraite executable existe (MACH-1.4 quitte NOT_IMPLEMENTED) ou si la ligne F-META-006 obtient une forme executable ; la couverture stricte doit alors repasser a 188/188 sans exemption. Reexamen obligatoire au plus tard le 2027-02-12 (90 jours apres l'approbation humaine du 2026-11-12).
exemptions.approved_by: Rwanbt (responsable du projet) — approbation explicite en session le 2026-11-12, reponse « 1 - ok » a la demande d'approbation de l'exemption F-META-006.

line_coverage_exemptions.owner_decision: S5, APPROUVÉ par le responsable, 2026-11-14 : « Objectif de couverture : 100 % lignes et régions du CODE PRODUIT, hors modules #[cfg(test)] et hors chemins inatteignables documentés un par un. » Ce bloc est la liste « un par un ».
line_coverage_exemptions.policy: Une entrée n'est admise que si AUCUNE entrée de programme acceptée n'emprunte la ligne, et chaque entrée porte la preuve (test qui exécute le refus, mesure, ou argument statique sur le parseur/checker). Une entrée n'est PAS une auto-approbation : elle reste `PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL`, n'est jamais défalquée du chiffre brut, et le chiffre « objectif S5 » est publié séparément. Une entrée sans preuve est interdite ; une ligne inatteignable non listée reste une dette de couverture comptée. Ce fichier ne modifie aucun seuil (`tools/coverage_thresholds.json`).
line_coverage_exemptions.measured_on: 2026-11-14 (vague 3, agent F), branche goal/wave-3 + branche wave3/f-coverage-mutation

entries.summary: `slot_of` on a tuple or field step whose base is not a tuple or a struct.
entries.why_unreachable: `slot_of` is only asked about the steps after the first fixed-size array index, while each previous step still had a slot. The base of such a step is then an array element, a tuple item or a struct field, and typeck types `x.0` / `x.f` only on a tuple / struct or a reference to one. A reference cannot be stored in an array, tuple or struct in Core (E-OWN-REF-ESCAPE), so the base is the tuple or struct itself.
entries.review_condition: Des références stockables dans un agrégat.

entries.summary: `planned_path` on a node that is not an element path.
entries.why_unreachable: A node gets a `PathMode` only from `plan`: a move or borrow access is recorded by `walk_path` after `element_path(expr)` returned `Some`, and `planned_path` calls the same pure function on the same expression and facts. A re-initialisation target is recorded only when `OwnFacts::element_reinit` holds it, which `element_write` sets only for a place with an array index, and that index is on a fixed-size array (a `Vec` element cannot be moved out, E-OWN-PARTIAL-MOVE).
entries.review_condition: Un mode de chemin attribué hors de `walk_path`.

entries.summary: Moving out through an index of something that is not a fixed-size array.
entries.why_unreachable: Past the first fixed-size array index the moved value is consumed step by step; an index of a `Vec` or a slice there would move a `Vec` element out, which the ownership checker refuses (E-OWN-PARTIAL-MOVE "déplacement d'un élément de `Vec` par indexation interdit").
evidence: ravum-lang build of `let x = a[0].v[0];` with `v: Vec<String>`: E-OWN-PARTIAL-MOVE
entries.review_condition: Le déplacement hors d'un `Vec` par indexation.

entries.summary: A re-initialised element whose path goes past the constant run.
entries.why_unreachable: `element_write` records a re-initialisation only when no opaque index follows the first array index, and a `Vec` element is never moved out (E-OWN-PARTIAL-MOVE). Field and tuple steps always have a slot (E-LINE-EMIT-PATHS-SLOT-NON-AGGREGATE), so the constant run stops only at a literal index past the end of a fixed-size array, which the branch just above lowers to a run-time panic.
entries.review_condition: Une réinitialisation à travers un index non constant.

entries.summary: A binding identity recorded for an expression whose resolution is not a local (debug cross-check).
entries.why_unreachable: The ownership checker publishes a binding identity only in `eval_place_expr`, for a slot found by `path_local_slot` or `lookup("self")`. With the facts of a checked program every path has a resolution, and `path_local_slot` returns a slot only for `Resolution::Local`; `self` is always resolved to a local by typeck (`check_self_value`).
entries.review_condition: Une identité de liaison publiée hors de `eval_place_expr`.

entries.summary: `syntactic_place` on `self` or a single-segment path that does not resolve to a local (debug cross-check).
entries.why_unreachable: `syntactic_place` is called on the expressions of `OwnFacts::place` and on the bases of their projections, and by the element-path cross-check on roots of projections. Every recorded place starts at a local slot, `self` always resolves to a local, and a projection rooted at a constant or function does not type-check (constants are scalars or `&str`: E-TYP-CONST for aggregates; fields and indexes of those are E-TYP-* errors).

entries.summary: The user `main` or a test function without an entry in `index.fns`.
entries.why_unreachable: `Index::build` records an `FnEntry` for every function item it walks; `user_main` is filtered to raw items of kind `Fn` and the tests are collected from function items during the same walk.
entries.review_condition: Un `main` ou un test hors de l'index.

entries.summary: A module node missing from the index.
entries.why_unreachable: `emit_module` walks the same module tree as `Index::walk_module`, which registers every module it enters (the root and each `ItemKind::Mod`) before walking its items.
entries.review_condition: Des modules émis hors de l'arbre indexé.

entries.summary: `register_source` refusing the manifest of a dependency.
entries.why_unreachable: A dependency manifest is registered under `<key>/ravum.toml`, and the key must equal the target's `package.name` (E-MOD-DEPENDENCY otherwise), so one canonical manifest always comes with the same display name and an existing id is reused; a new id comes from a counter that only grows, so `add_at` never meets a taken id.
evidence: ravum-lang check of `other = { path = "../util" }`: E-MOD-DEPENDENCY "dependency key `other` does not match the target `package.name`"
entries.review_condition: Des clés de dépendance différentes du nom du paquet.

entries.summary: `fs::canonicalize` failing on a dependency directory whose components were just checked.
entries.why_unreachable: Every component of the dependency path was checked with `symlink_metadata` just above: it exists and is not a symbolic link. `canonicalize` can then fail only if the tree changes between the two system calls (a concurrent removal), which no test can schedule deterministically.
entries.review_condition: Une résolution qui ne vérifie plus chaque composant.

entries.summary: A canonical dependency directory outside the package parent.
entries.why_unreachable: The lexical pass refuses any `..` that climbs above the package parent (E-MOD-PATH-ESCAPE), every component is then checked not to be a symbolic link, and `pkg_dir` is itself canonical (the root is canonicalized in loader/files.rs, a dependency directory is the canonical path returned here). The canonical path is therefore the lexical one, which stays inside the parent.
evidence: ravum-lang check of a package reached through a symlinked directory with a `../util` dependency: accepted
entries.review_condition: Un répertoire de paquet non canonique.

entries.summary: An inline module without a name.
entries.why_unreachable: Only the root module of a file has `name: None`; the parser builds every `mod name { ... }` with `Some(name)` (an unnamed `mod { }` is E-PARSE-EXPECTED), and `expand_module` only reaches inline modules through `ItemKind::Mod` items.

entries.summary: `fs::canonicalize` failing on a module file that was just found.
entries.why_unreachable: The candidate was just found to exist (`is_file`/`is_dir`) and checked by `check_lexical_no_symlinks`; `canonicalize` can then fail only if the tree changes between the system calls, which no test can schedule deterministically.
entries.review_condition: Une recherche de module qui ne vérifie plus l'existence.

entries.summary: A dependency whose crate root fails to load after the graph accepted it.
entries.why_unreachable: Before `load_crates` merges a dependency, `collect_dependencies` refused a missing or symlinked `src/lib.rv`, and the package digest read every file of the dependency under the same size and encoding limits (E-LIMIT-FILE-SIZE, E-UNSUPPORTED-TOKEN). `load_crate_root` can then fail only if the tree changes in between.
entries.review_condition: Un chargement des dépendances sans graphe ni empreinte préalables.
